subject.title: fix(gateway): add per-request cancellation to prevent late node.invoke dispatch

question: What additive Gateway contract should make the caller's timeout or abort authoritative on a persistent WebSocket, including the already-effecting node case?
rationale: The current request frame carries no cancellation or deadline, while substituting the plugin approval maximum neither matches caller lifetime nor defines terminal effect semantics.

options.title: Explicit cancel or deadline
options.body: Add request-scoped cancellation or deadline metadata and allow cancellation to win only before node dispatch begins.

options.title: Server-owned request timeout
options.body: Define one server deadline only after proving compatibility across long-running Gateway methods and callers with custom timeouts.

options.title: Split the mitigation
options.body: Preserve the disconnect and atomic pre-dispatch guards here while tracking persistent-socket timeout cancellation as separate protocol work.

recommendation.title: Explicit cancel or deadline
recommendation.body: Add request-scoped cancellation or deadline metadata and allow cancellation to win only before node dispatch begins.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue and strongest merged history across the affected security boundary point to this owner for the protocol decision.
